subject: English Language
name: Basic 4 English Language
description: The Basic 4 English Language curriculum focuses on consolidating and extending literacy skills. It emphasizes oral language development through songs, poetry, and drama, and advances reading skills with a focus on comprehension, fluency, and summarizing. It also introduces more complex writing tasks and grammar usage.

strands.title: Oral Language (Listening and Speaking)
strands.description: Developing listening and speaking skills through songs, poetry, storytelling, dramatisation, conversation, and listening comprehension.

subStrands.title: Songs
subStrands.description: Using songs to develop critical thinking and cultural awareness.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of a variety of songs

exemplars.description: Listen to a variety of songs and sing them.
Discuss the theme and values in the song.
Express personal opinion on the songs.
Listen to a variety of poems.
Recite poems with appropriate stress and intonation.
Discuss values in the poems.

subStrands.title: Story Telling
subStrands.description: Developing storytelling skills and analyzing narratives.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of the main idea and supporting points in texts

indicators.description: Identify the main idea and supporting ideas in stories

exemplars.description: Listen to stories and identify the main ideas.
Identify supporting ideas in the stories.
Retell the story in their own words highlighting the main and supporting ideas.

subStrands.title: Dramatisation
subStrands.description: Using drama to interpret stories and express cultural values.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of roles and characters in stories

exemplars.description: Listen to a story and identify the characters.
Discuss the roles of the characters.
Role-play the characters in the story.
Discuss the moral lessons in the story.

subStrands.title: Conversation
subStrands.description: Engaging in meaningful conversations on various topics.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of how to express oneself in a conversation

indicators.description: Engage in conversation on everyday issues

exemplars.description: Discuss everyday issues such as personal hygiene, good manners, and safety.
Use appropriate vocabulary and expressions in conversations.
Take turns in conversations and respect the views of others.

subStrands.title: Listening Comprehension
subStrands.description: Listening for specific information and understanding.

indicators.description: Listen to texts and answer questions

exemplars.description: Listen to a variety of texts (narrative, descriptive, expository).
Answer literal and inferential questions on the text.
Summarise the text heard.

strands.title: Reading
strands.description: Developing reading skills through phonics, vocabulary, comprehension, and fluency.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of phonics for reading

indicators.description: Use phonics knowledge to decode words

exemplars.description: Identify and blend sounds to read words.
Read words with consonant blends, digraphs, and diphthongs.
Use word families to read new words.

subStrands.title: Vocabulary
subStrands.description: Expanding vocabulary and understanding word meanings.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of word meanings and usage

indicators.description: Use context clues to determine the meaning of unknown words

exemplars.description: Read sentences and paragraphs containing unknown words.
Use clues in the text to guess the meaning of the words.
Verify meanings using a dictionary.

subStrands.title: Comprehension
subStrands.description: Applying strategies to understand and analyze texts.

indicators.description: Read and answer questions on texts

exemplars.description: Read a variety of texts suited for the level.
Answer literal, inferential, and critical thinking questions.
Identify the main idea and supporting details.

subStrands.title: Fluency
subStrands.description: Reading with speed, accuracy, and expression.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate the ability to read with fluency

indicators.description: Read level-appropriate texts with accuracy and speed

exemplars.description: Read passages aloud observing punctuation marks.
Read with appropriate expression and intonation.
Engage in choral and pair reading activities.
